thread:
Priya Patel: KPMG asked for control mapping and evidence for: RBAC changes (Oct→Mar), KMS key rotation schedule, and audit log retention/exports. They want CSV of changes, KMS key ARNs, and proof of access reviews. Can we assemble by EOD tomorrow? Links they sent: https://kpmg.example/audit-request
Sam Nguyen: Ok. I'll grab RBAC diffs from Git. We changed policies in infra repo: `infra/iam/policies/*` in Dec. I'll export commit range: `git log --pretty=oneline --since=2024-12-01 --until=2025-03-01 -- infra/iam` — will attach.
Maya Sec: For KMS, we have rotation enabled on the prod and staging keys. Command to list keys and rotation: `aws kms list-keys --profile redwood-prod` then `aws kms get-key-rotation-status --key-id <key-id>`.
Ethan Li: For audit logs, CloudTrail exports to S3 with lifecycle 7 years. I'll generate a signed S3 manifest and an index. Also can pull access logs for console/API with `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-03-01T00:00:00Z`.
Priya Patel: Auditor also asked for evidence of last access review date and reviewer sign-off. We have quarterly attestation tickets in Jira: RD-SEC-ATT-2025Q1. Can someone attach the ticket and screenshot of the approval comment?
Sam Nguyen: I'll attach the git diff and a short table mapping policy names -> roles -> change reason. Example snippet:
```
policy: service-readonly
role: analytics
change: removed s3:PutObject allowed (least privilege)
commit: 3f2a1b
```
Maya Sec: I'll export KMS metadata CSV with ARN, alias, rotation_enabled, creation_date, last_rotated. Also include KMS CMK ids and the CMEK mapping used in GCP buckets.
Ethan Li: Added S3 signed manifest link: s3://redwood-audit-exports/2025-03-12/cloudtrail-manifest.json (shared in drive). Also attached a short playbook proving retention config and lifecycle rule ID rw-audit-lifecycle.
Priya Patel: Good. Auditor follow-up: they want proof that RBAC changes were reviewed by change advisory board (CAB). We have CAB minutes — can someone redact PII and upload?
Maya Sec: I'll redact and upload minutes. Also suggest adding an assertion file mapping each control (SOC2 CC6.1, ISO A.9) to the artifacts: RBAC diffs/Jira ticket/KMS CSV/S3 manifest. Drafting now.
ops-bot: Reminder: scheduled snapshot export job ran at 2025-03-12T02:00Z and uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-exports/2025-03-12/ (job id: export-20250312-02). :white_check_mark:
Priya Patel: Thanks. Can we have a single zip with index.csv mapping artifact -> control -> link? auditor asked for simple mapping format.
Sam Nguyen: I'll create index.csv with columns: artifact, path, control, reviewer, date. Will push to the audit bucket and post link here.
Ethan Li: Quick Q: auditor asked about KMS key material origin (AWS-managed vs customer-managed). We need to confirm which keys are AWS-managed. Maya?
Maya Sec: Prod CMKs are customer-managed (alias/redwood/prod/*). Some service-managed keys exist for RDS snapshots; I'll annotate those in the CSV.
Priya Patel: Great — target: assemble artifacts + index by 2025-03-13 18:00 PT. Any blockers?
Sam Nguyen: None from my side.
Maya Sec: Need a reviewer for the mapping doc — @Priya can you review before upload?
Priya Patel: Yep will review.
Ethan Li: I'll also prepare a short readout for auditors on incident response tie-in: how RBAC changes are logged and how we triage related anomalies.
Priya Patel: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll reply to the auditor with ETA and link to the folder once uploads complete. :thumbsup:
